signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: Your rolls and photos stay. Sign in again any time.

editCard.title: Edit card
editCard.failed: Couldn’t save your card. Try again.

username.title: Username
username.limit: You can change it twice every 14 days
username.body: Your old handle becomes free for anyone after the change.
username.failed: Couldn’t change your username. Try again.
username.laterBody: Usernames change at most twice every 14 days, so people can find each other.

password.title: Password
password.socialBodyApple: There’s no Everglow password to change. Manage your Apple ID in Settings › Apple Account.
password.socialBodyGoogle: There’s no Everglow password to change. Manage your Google Account in its settings.
password.socialBodyOther: There’s no Everglow password to change. Manage it where you sign in.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.body: You don’t see each other’s photos, except in rolls one of you hosts.
blocked.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the people you blocked.

delete.title: Delete your
delete.keepBody: They stay until each roll closes, unsigned
delete.rollsEdge: Rolls you started or are alone on
delete.rollsBody: A roll you host alone goes to its longest-standing member. One with no one else on it is deleted with its photos.
delete.rollStays: Stays with the people on it
delete.rollDeleted: Deleted · no one else on it
delete.kept: Reports about you or by you, and copies of reported photos, are kept for up to a year for safety and legal reasons, then removed.
delete.note: Can’t be undone · sign-in is removed too
delete.choose: Choose what happens to your frames first

deleted.title: Your account
deleted.body: Thanks for the photos. You can start again any time.

suspended.title: Your account is
suspended.body: You can’t join, add or change anything while Everglow reviews it. You can still delete your account.
